assessment_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2H-C-R - Reproducibility Completeness Assessment

REPRODUCIBLE_WITH_PERMITTED_FILES: All unit and adversarial regression tests (602 research tests).
Double-entry Decimal accounting oracle identity verification (Equity = Assets - Liabilities == Flow Equity).
Activation boundary guards and persistent disk-lock restart survival.
Synthetic causal simulation stress scenarios and crash-recovery verification.
Host Builderr admission preview (preview.py), selfcheck (selfcheck.py), and strategy selftest (strategy_selftest.py).
REPRODUCIBLE_ONLY_WITH_AUTHORIZED_PRIVAT: Historical replay backtests covering 2018-2021 (Tier 1 & Tier 2) requiring pre-2022 historical price fixtures.
Historical baseline reconciliation between Stage 1 ($233k) and Stage 2B ($135k) corporate-action adjusted series.
NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_REPRODUCIBLE: Unsealed Tier 3 prospective market observations (dates >= 2022-01-01) which remain strictly sealed to prevent lookahead contamination.
Live broker execution or live exchange order routing (permanently prohibited by protocol).

reproducibility_requirements.standard_library_isolation: Zero third-party packages required for agent.py, comparator d2, or Decimal accounting oracles.
reproducibility_requirements.cross_platform_guarantee: Windows, Linux, and macOS supported without compilation or binary extensions.
